central_question: Construct, or rule out in an explicitly broad declared circuit class, a uniform exact evaluator for the marked-generator oriented Kummer root with all-in complexity strictly below the square-root frontier.

forbidden_free_inputs: orientation values indexed by subgroup components
a supplied analytic or p-adic branch
an uncharged Omega(sqrt(n)) table or memory-time product
cost_gate.goal: C_total = O(n^(1/2-epsilon)) for some fixed epsilon>0 on the declared scaling family

evidence_boundaries.degree: high polynomial degree alone is not an arithmetic-circuit lower bound
evidence_boundaries.finite_pattern: not promotable without a symbolic law and held-out transfer
evidence_boundaries.negative_screens: do not constitute a universal lower bound
evidence_boundaries.toy_interpolation: ground truth only, not a candidate evaluator

first_execution_package.purpose: freeze the contract and build independently replayable exact toy ground truth

target.bit_peeling: an exact evaluator yields canonical scalar recovery in at most ceil(log2(n)) adaptive calls
target.canonical_scalar: the unique integer k with 0 <= k < n and Q=[k]G
target.curve_family: short Weierstrass y^2 = x^3 + a*x + b over F_p; primary fixed curve secp256k1 has a=0,b=7
target.oriented_root: the unique polynomial of degree < (n-1)/2 satisfying Y_G(x([j]G))=(-1)^j*y([j]G) for 1 <= j <= (n-1)/2
target.subgroup: H=<G> of odd prime order n

toy_corpus.role: finite exact ground truth only; no unknown-target or asymptotic claim
toy_corpus.source: exactly the five frozen prime-order y^2=x^3+7 curves from experiments/parity_lift_000/char_parity_toy_screen.py

required: one declared algorithmic rule across a scaling family
explicit dependence on E,G,Q and public secp256k1 constants
